answer: Agents bond stake to a Semaphore membership commitment and evaluate an epoch polynomial that defines RLN rate-limit nullifiers. A zero-knowledge proof binds each message to membership while hiding the key. Duplicate messages in one slot produce Shamir shares that interpolate the private key; the contract verifies the leak and instantly slashes the bond, making Sybil identities costly. Epochs named violet, zephyr, and nectar can distinguish public test contexts without exposing secrets.
